title: Word Search
summary: Find themed words hidden in a grid of letters, in Slovak or English
description:
**Word Search** is a calm puzzle of hidden words: every grid has a theme and a list of words running across, down and diagonally, and backwards in the harder ones. Drag across a word, or tap its first and last letter, and it gets a bright highlighter capsule. No ads, no coins, no lives, no account.

**Real Slovak, and English too**

- 46 themes in each language, from the farm and the forest to music, jobs and outer space, written for this game: common nouns only, more than 1,600 words in each language.
- Slovak grids use the real Slovak alphabet: letters with accents are letters of their own, and CH is one letter in one square, as in Slovak crosswords. The other letters of the grid follow how often each letter turns up in the language, so a grid reads naturally.
- Switch between Slovak and English words with one tap on the labelled button at the top; each language keeps its own progress.

**A hidden message**

- Most puzzles hide a message in the letters no word uses, often an old saying. Find every word and the leftover letters light up one by one and spell it, read row by row.

**How it plays**

- Drag in a straight line; the selection snaps to the nearest direction, so you need not be exact. Tapping the first and the last letter works too, and so does a keyboard.
- Found words are crossed off the list in the colour of their capsule.
- Hints are free and never run out: tap a word in the list for its first letter, or to outline where it is.
- Grids grow from 7 × 7 to 12 × 12 as you play, adding more diagonals and then backwards words. Or keep one difficulty: Easy, Medium, or Hard, where the list shows only how long each word is.
- An optional timer, off until you want it.

**Daily puzzle and your collection**

- A new daily puzzle every day, the same for everyone who plays in the same language, growing through the week from 8 × 8 on Monday to 12 × 12 on Sunday. A calendar shows the days you solved and your streak, and missed days can still be played.
- Endless themed puzzles, and any theme you like whenever you want it.
- Every word you find goes into your collection; a theme is complete once you have found all its words.
- Statistics for each language: puzzles solved, daily streaks, words found, themes complete, best times by grid size.

**Easy to use**

- The grid always fits the screen, upright or sideways, with letters as large as the room allows.
- Three letter sizes (picked from your phone's text size until you choose), high contrast, light and dark.
- In English or Slovak, following your phone, or chosen in the game.

**What it never does**

- No ads, no in-app purchases, no coins, no lives and no waiting: nothing to buy and nothing to unlock.
- No account and no sign-in.
- No internet access: the game works offline and cannot connect anywhere.
- No analytics or tracking of any kind.

Your progress, collection and settings are saved as you play and stay on your phone, in the app's own data.
